name: boldkit
title: BoldKit base
description: Everything a project needs before adding BoldKit components: the neubrutalism stylesheet + motion system, the default theme, cn() utils, and the Outfit / DM Mono fonts. Use with `shadcn init --base`.
docs: Next: in your root CSS file, replace @import "tailwindcss" with @import "./styles/globals.css" (adjust the path to where it was installed). BoldKit's stylesheet imports Tailwind itself and defines the colour variables and @theme mapping.
